resources.name: Crystal structures of Li3AlN2 and Li3GaN2

access.notes: Space group Ia-3 (No. 206), Wyckoff positions 48e, 16c, 8a, 24d. Lattice constants and internal parameters from Juza & Hund 1948, Juza et al. 1968, or ICSD.
Extracted from the paper: Li3GaN2 (R_Li=2.03, R_Ga=1.73, R_N=1.84 a.u.); Li3AlN2 (R_Li=1.99, R_Al=1.65, R_N=1.80 a.u.). Must be used as given.
Helper tools for post-processing; not strictly required.
